Families of military service members and veterans face some unique challenges such as disruptions in parenting. Learn how families may be affected.
Military service members and veterans face life-threatening injuries, mental health problems and problems from exposure to environmental hazards.
subsections: What types of injuries do service members face?
What other special health problems do service members face?
What mental health issues do service members and veterans face?
What health care services are available to service members and veterans?

meta_desc: Viruses cause familiar infections such as the common cold, but they also cause severe illnesses. Learn more about viral infections and their symptoms.
subsections: What are the treatments for viral infections?

meta_desc: Vision impairment (low vision) and blindness can have many causes. If you lose vision, you can't get it back. But there are ways to manage; learn how.
subsections: What are the types of low vision?
What are the treatments for low vision?
How can I make the most of my remaining sight?

meta_desc: Your vital signs show how well your body is functioning. They include blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate (or pulse), and temperature.
Vitamin A is an antioxidant. Vitamin A plays a role in your vision, bone growth, reproduction, cell functions and immune system.
Vitamin C is an antioxidant.  It is important for your skin, bones, and connective tissue. It promotes healing and helps the body absorb iron.
Vitamin D helps your body absorb calcium. You can get Vitamin D in three ways: through your skin, from your diet, and from supplements.
subsections: Why do I need vitamin D?
How do I get vitamin D?
How much vitamin D do I need?

meta_desc: A lack of vitamin D (deficiency) can affect your bones and overall health. Learn who is at risk, how much vitamin D you need, and how to get enough.
subsections: Why do I need vitamin D and how do I get it?
How much vitamin D do I need?
Who is at risk of vitamin D deficiency?
What problems does vitamin D deficiency cause?

Can too much vitamin D be harmful?

meta_desc: Vitamin E is an antioxidant. It plays a role in your immune system and metabolic processes. People with certain disorders may need extra Vitamin E.
Vitamin K makes proteins for healthy bones and tissues. It also makes proteins for blood clotting. There are different types of vitamin K.
Vitamins are substances that your body needs to grow and develop normally. There are 13 vitamins your body needs; Each has specific jobs.
Vitiligo causes white patches on your skin. It occurs when the cells that give your skin its color are destroyed. Learn about possible treatments.
VLDL is one of the "bad" types of cholesterol. Having too much can lead to a buildup of cholesterol in your arteries. Learn how to lower your VLDL level.
subsections: How do I know what my VLDL level is?
What should my VLDL level be?
How can I lower my VLDL level?

meta_desc: Overusing your vocal cords can lead to various voice disorders such as polyps, nodules or sores on the cords. These signs may indicate a disorder.
A volcano is a vent in the Earth's crust. Volcanic gas and ash can damage the lungs of infants, older adults, and people with respiratory illnesses.
Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome (VHL) is a rare genetic disease that causes tumors and cysts to grow in your body. Learn about symptoms and treatment.
subsections: What are the symptoms of Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome (VHL)?
How is Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome (VHL) diagnosed?
What are the treatments for Von Hippel-Lindau syndrome (VHL)?

meta_desc: Vulvar cancer is cancer of the labia or skin of a woman's genitals. It is very rare, but treatable. Having HPV is a risk factor. Get more details here.
Vulvar disorders are conditions that affect the outer female genitals such as pain, skin conditions, infections or cancer. Find out more.
subsections: Who is more likely to develop vulvar disorders?
What are the symptoms of vulvar disorders?
What are the treatments for vulvar disorders?

meta_desc: The term "gait" refers to how a person walks. An abnormal gait might be caused by an underlying physical condition, disease or injury. Read more here.
subsections: How is the cause of a walking problem diagnosed?
What are the treatments for walking problems?

meta_desc: Warts or verruca are skin growths caused by an infection with humanpallilloma virus or HPV. Types of warts include common, plantar, genital and flat.
Many different pollutants can harm our rivers, streams, lakes, and oceans. Learn how water pollution can cause plants to die and other problems.
Playing in the water can be fun, but it can also be dangerous. Water safety can help prevent injuries and drowning. Learn how to stay safe.
About two thirds of adults in the U.S. are overweight or obese. A weight control strategy can help you keep a healthy weight.
subsections: What factors affect weight and health?
How can I get to and stay at a healthy weight?
How can I maintain my weight loss?

meta_desc: Is weight loss surgery for you? Learn about types of surgery including bariatric surgery, bypass surgery, gastric banding, and more.
West Nile Virus (WNV) is a virus spread by mosquito bites. Most people have few to no symptoms. But some have severe symptoms. Learn about prevention and treatment.
subsections: How does West Nile Virus spread?
Who is more likely to develop West Nile Virus?
What are the symptoms of West Nile Virus?
How is West Nile Virus diagnosed?
What are the treatments for West Nile Virus?
Can West Nile Virus be prevented?

meta_desc: Whooping cough (Pertussis) is an infectious bacterial disease that causes uncontrollable coughing. Learn about the vaccine, symptoms, and treatment.
subsections: What are the symptoms of whooping cough?
What are the treatments for whooping cough?

meta_desc: Wildfires are extremely dangerous. They spread quickly and can destroy homes. The smoke can affect your health. Learn how to be prepared.
Wilms' Tumor (or Nephroblastoma) is a rare type of cancer that affects one or both kidneys. Find a list of symptoms and treatments associated
Wilson disease is a disorder that prevents your body from getting rid of extra copper. Too much copper can affect the liver and nervous system.
Winter weather emergencies can lead to health and safety challenges. Take actions to protect yourself by having a disaster plan.
subsections: What kinds of problems can severe winter weather cause?
How can I prepare for a winter weather emergency?

meta_desc: Women have unique health issues throughout their lives. Preventive care and screening tests can help lower the risk of certain diseases, detect problems early, and improve outcomes.
Women's health checkup exams and screenings may include a pelvic exam, pap test, mammogram, clinical breast exam and testing for HPV.
Cuts, scratches, bruises, and lacerations are types of injuries of the skin or soft tissues. Find first aid tips and how to deal with accidents here.
Wrist pain can be caused by repetitive motions, injuries or other problems. Learn about various wrist disorders and injuries here.
subsections: What are the types of wrist injuries and disorders?
Who is at risk for wrist injuries and disorders?
What are the symptoms of wrist injuries and disorders?
How are wrist injuries and disorders diagnosed?
What are the treatments for wrist injuries and disorders?
Can wrist injuries and disorders be prevented?

meta_desc: X-rays are a type of radiation called electromagnetic waves. X-ray imaging creates pictures of the inside of your body.
subsections: How do you prepare for an x-ray?
What should you expect after an x-ray?

meta_desc: A yeast infection (also called candidiasis) is fungal infection that affects different body parts. Get the facts on it and associated problems.
Zika is a virus that is spread by mosquitoes. Most people who get the virus do not get sick. A blood test can tell if you have Zika.
